levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر

notes: «حدثني أبي ... وجماعة مشايخي» : the father is a bare relation and the group of shaykhs is unnamed; they are co-transmitters at one level
the Imam's words («قال لي يا عبد الملك») follow the chain; the chain ends at Abu Abdullah, written after «عن», so a narrator
the bracketed word in the saying is not a link
